basis: Based only on the documents provided.

requirements.quote: The deadline for submission of Bids is 30 November 2026, 14:00 hours Corvessa time (UTC+03:00).
requirements.reason: Body §5 states 30 November 2026, 14:00 (UTC+03:00); Annex 1 ITB 23.1 states 2 December 2026, 14:00. The planned upload 2026-11-26 16:00 UTC+03:00 is earlier than both.
requirements.bidder_action: Keep the planned upload time and wait for the agency's answer to C1.

requirements.quote: Form of Bid (Form BF-1), signed by the authorized signatory and bearing the Bidder's company seal
requirements.reason: QMJV_BF1.pdf is listed with seal: no; §3(a) asks for the company seal.
requirements.bidder_action: Add the company seal to the Form of Bid.

requirements.quote: Power of Attorney authorizing the signatory of the Bid
The Power of Attorney shall be notarized.
requirements.bidder_action: Have the Power of Attorney notarized.

requirements.quote: Certificate of Incorporation (a copy is acceptable)
requirements.reason: A copy is listed; §3(c) accepts a copy.

requirements.quote: Tax Clearance Certificate issued by the competent tax authority

A Tax Clearance Certificate is valid for 90 days from its date of issue (for example, a certificate issued on 1 March is valid through 30 May). The certificate must be valid on the deadline for submission of Bids.
requirements.reason: Issued 2026-08-20, valid through 2026-11-18. Expired under both readings of C1.
requirements.bidder_action: Obtain a newer Tax Clearance Certificate.

requirements.quote: Audited financial statements for the years 2023, 2024 and 2025
The audited financial statements for 2023, 2024 and 2025 shall be merged into a single PDF file (document code FIN).
requirements.reason: Three separate files instead of one merged file.
requirements.bidder_action: Merge the three statements into QMJV_FIN.pdf.

requirements.quote: Price Schedule (Form BF-3), signed by the authorized signatory
requirements.reason: QMJV_BF3.xlsx is listed as signed: no.

requirements.quote: Bid Security (Form BF-2) in the amount of USD 12,000.
requirements.reason: No Bid Security file in the list.

requirements.quote: The Bid Security shall remain valid until 28 April 2027.
requirements.reason: Depends on R12, which has no file.
requirements.bidder_action: When adding the Bid Security, make it valid until at least 28 April 2027.

requirements.quote: a JV Agreement or a Letter of Intent to form a JV, in either case signed by all members
requirements.reason: JV declared. QMJV_JVA.pdf is signed by the lead member only.
requirements.bidder_action: Have every member sign the JV Agreement.

requirements.quote: a JV Member Information Form (Form BF-4) for each member, with that member's Certificate of Incorporation attached.
requirements.reason: Two members declared; one form listed (Quillfield). The second member's form is not listed.
requirements.bidder_action: Add Form BF-4 for Merrowind Cloud Ltd.

requirements.quote: Bids may be submitted by a single firm or by a joint venture (JV) of not more than three (3) firms.
requirements.reason: JV of 2 members; the limit is 3.

requirements.quote: All files shall be in PDF format.
requirements.bidder_action: Convert the Price Schedule to PDF.

requirements.quote: No single file may exceed 10 MB.
requirements.reason: QMJV_TEC.pdf is 14.2 MB, over the 10 MB limit.
requirements.bidder_action: Reduce QMJV_TEC.pdf to 10 MB or less.

requirements.quote: Each file shall be named [BidderShortName]_[DocumentCode].pdf, using the document codes in the Submission Checklist below (example: ABC_BF1.pdf).
requirements.reason: FIN_2023.pdf, FIN_2024.pdf and FIN_2025.pdf lack the QMJV_ prefix; QMJV_BF3.xlsx does not end in .pdf.

sides.quote: The deadline for submission of Bids is 30 November 2026, 14:00 hours Corvessa time (UTC+03:00).
The deadline for submission of Bids is: Date: 2 December 2026; Time: 14:00 hours.

conflicts.agency_question: Section 5 of the RFB states 30 November 2026, 14:00 hours (UTC+03:00), but Annex 1, BDS ITB 23.1 states 2 December 2026, 14:00 hours. Is the deadline for submission of Bids 30 November 2026, 14:00 hours Corvessa time (UTC+03:00)? (Yes/No)
